newsitem.title: USA: Metal Recovery gets $5.5 mln funding nod.
newsitem.headline: Metal Recovery gets $5.5 mln funding nod.

text.p: Metal Recovery Technologies Inc said on Friday that the U.S. Department of Energy has approved a $5.5 million funding to develop a new facility to dezinc scrap metal.

The company also said it has begun production at the world's first continuous scrap degalvanizing facility and will dezinc about 10,000 tons of scrap yielding 9,750 tons of high-grade black scrap steel and 250 tons of 99.8 percent pure zinc by the end of 1996.
It said the 1997 production target for the Midwest steel-belt facility is to recycle 200,000 tons of galvanized steel scrap that would yield 195,000 tons of black scrap and about 5,000 tons of zinc.
